title: Target Pair Witness
description: Given an integer array and a target value, find the zero-based indices of two different elements whose sum equals the target. Return the pair in increasing index order.
constraints: 2 <= n <= 100000; -10^9 <= values[i], target <= 10^9; exactly one valid pair exists.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n integers. Third line: target.
outputFormat: Print the two indices in increasing order.
hints: For every value, check whether its required complement has already appeared.

examples.explanation: The values 1 and 9 add up to 10, and their zero-based indices are 1 and 2.
The values 5 and 6 add up to 11, and their zero-based indices are 2 and 3.
